$description: Approved icons. Material Symbols Sharp, weight 300, unfilled, from @material-symbols/svg-300 (Apache-2.0). Build compiles them into an SVG sprite; ids are cx-icon-{key}. Use an icon only for the role listed; anything else is a new entry in this file (minor version).

arrow-forward.use: Forward journeys: primary and secondary buttons, standalone links, Next in pagination.

arrow-back.use: Back links at the top of posts and case studies; Previous in pagination.

arrow-upward.use: Back to top, in the footer only.

arrow-outward.use: After the text of a link that leaves the site.

content-copy.use: Copy button on code blocks, at rest.

check.use: Confirmation that a copy (or similar one-off action) succeeded.

theme-light.use: Theme toggle while the dark theme is showing: the action is switch to light.

theme-dark.use: Theme toggle while the light theme is showing: the action is switch to dark.

expand.use: Disclosure indicator on <summary>; rotates when open.

pause.use: Pause control for the specimen plate's drift while it is running.

play.use: Resume control for ambient motion while it is paused.
